verdict.rationale: ADK positions itself as 'designed to be written by both humans and AI' with AI-aware developer resources and an Agents CLI meant to be driven from AI-enabled dev environments, and 'Agent Config' lets you build agents without code — hinting at natural-language/AI-driven operation. But the core interaction model is still Python code, YAML config, and explicit CLI commands (adk run, adk deploy), not natural-language commands to the tool itself. Missing for 10: concrete example of issuing a natural-language instruction that ADK's CLI/tooling directly interprets and executes, and independent confirmation beyond vendor docs.
